turns.zh: 总得有一方要让步，而我看到的标普500真正突破上行的唯一路径，就是利率市场出现缓解，让许多这些被砸下去的股票能上来喘口气。

turns.en: This is a highly tense moment in the equity markets and it will be interesting to see how this continues to develop into next week. Alright, let's turn to the dollar Patrick because it continues to make new higher highs while the year was broken to a lower low.
turns.zh: 这是股市里一个高度紧张的时刻，看看它下周如何继续发展会很有意思。好，我们来转向美元，Patrick，因为它继续在创出更高的高点，而欧元则跌破了更低的低点。

turns.en: Now positioning firmly favors the dollar while Europe faces energy pressures, political pressure across all its major economies. Now do you think this dollar strength remains the path of least resistance or really what does it mean for the broader financial conditions that we see a stronger and stronger dollar as we move forward here until the end of the year?
turns.zh: 眼下持仓明显偏向美元，而欧洲面临能源压力、以及其所有主要经济体都面临的政治压力。那么你觉得这种美元强势仍然是阻力最小的路径吗？或者说，随着我们在年底前看到美元越来越强，这对更广泛的金融状况到底意味着什么？

turns.en: Well, it was very timely that we had Brent on the show, but there continues to be funding stresses evident in the currency trends. We obviously had that 18-month trade range and the first attempt of the dollar to breakout or a few months ago never followed through, but here we have a very decisive breakout, but it's actually supported by a decisive breakdown in the euro.
turns.zh: 嗯，我们请 Brent 上节目真是非常及时，但货币走势里持续显现出融资压力（funding stress）。我们显然有过那个18个月的交易区间，几个月前美元第一次尝试突破并没有跟进，但这次我们有了一个非常果断的突破，而且它实际上是由欧元一次果断的破位所支撑的。

turns.en: The euro has cleared almost all the major support lines and is at this point, it looks like it has room to weaken even down to 110 or 108 as they continue to be the net energy importer and the most vulnerable for the supply disruption and it's manifesting on the currency volatility.
turns.zh: 欧元已经跌破了几乎所有主要支撑线，到这个时候，它看起来还有走弱的空间，甚至跌到110或108，因为他们持续是能源净进口方、是供应中断里最脆弱的一方，而这正体现在货币波动率上。

turns.en: So at this moment, the dollar is strengthening and it is the path of least resistance and continues to actually be one of the big macro drivers and so while there are all sorts of reasons why one could see that the US dollar could weaken in the long term, right now the current macro regime is US dollar rising and at least at this moment, there doesn't seem to be any immediate catalyst for this to reverse.
turns.zh: 所以此刻，美元在走强，它就是阻力最小的路径，并持续是宏观的大驱动因素之一；因此虽然有各种各样的理由让人觉得美元长期会走弱，但当下的宏观机制是美元上行，而且至少在此刻，似乎没有任何立刻能让它反转的催化剂。

turns.en: Alright Patrick, let's talk about crude because right now we're almost hitting $93 this morning as concerns reemerge about possible attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
turns.zh: 好，Patrick，我们来谈谈原油，因为眼下今早我们几乎要触及93美元，市场对霍尔木兹海峡（Strait of Hormuz）可能遭到袭击的担忧重新浮现。

turns.en: Now with inventories already depleted and speculative shorts elevated, could further escalation send oil back above $100? Well for certain, this remains the primary story because it becomes the catalyst that drives inflation expectations that ultimately is manifesting in these rates markets and so what oil does next is going to be critical.
turns.zh: 而在库存已经耗尽、投机性空头居高不下的情况下，进一步的升级会不会把油价重新送过100美元？嗯，可以肯定的是，这仍然是头号故事，因为它成了驱动通胀预期的催化剂，而通胀预期最终正体现在这些利率市场里，所以油价接下来怎么走将会至关重要。

turns.en: Now obviously the Oman lane matters and certainly there's obviously speculation that now there could be disruptions there. This is actually pretty critical because the market has been reliant on the movement of the barrels that are coming through that lane and the inventory cushion is very thin and so there is lots of room that if there is any escalation over there that oil does need to go higher and the interesting part is that the market is not positioned for this.
turns.zh: 显然，阿曼通道（Oman lane）很重要，而且现在有猜测说那里可能出现中断。这其实相当关键，因为市场一直依赖经由那条通道运输的原油，而库存缓冲非常薄，所以只要那边有任何升级，油价确有需要走高，空间很大；有意思的是，市场并没有为此做好持仓布局。

turns.en: We continue to see when we look at these caught reports, the gross shorts have actually hit a five year extreme and so there is not the speculative positioning in the commitment of trader reports that have suggested that speculators are positioned for a huge bull breakout and so there is lots of pent up energy here that could certainly drive that short term trend.
turns.zh: 我们持续看到，当我们查看这些 COT 报告（交易者持仓报告，Commitment of Traders）时，总空头其实已触及五年来的极值，所以在交易者持仓报告里，投机性持仓并没有显示出投机者为一次巨大的看涨突破做好了布局，因此这里憋着大量能量，肯定能推动那轮短期趋势。

turns.en: What continues to be super interesting is this $10 sharp reversal that we've seen in crude oil over the last couple of weeks is only really in the front month.
turns.zh: 一直超级有意思的是，过去几周我们在原油上看到的这波10美元的急剧反转，其实只发生在近月合约上。

turns.en: When you go to any longer term contracts such as the January or March contracts, they continue to make new highs and so there is clearly a market that is anticipating oil to remain under pressure and this becomes the single most important thing to watch going into the macro environment because if oil does make this breakout above 100 and heads higher certainly there is going to be responses in the rates of markets and maybe that will be all it takes
turns.zh: 当你转到任何更长期的合约，比如1月或3月合约时，它们继续在创新高，所以显然市场在预期油价将持续承压；而这成了进入宏观环境时要盯的头等大事，因为如果油价真的突破100、继续走高，利率市场肯定会有反应，也许那就是

turns.en: to in the end break down the equity markets from this highly vulnerable state. So this is certainly the thing to watch, oil is upticking here, will we get that clearance of the $95, $96 which will very clearly indicate to technicians that the next potential bull advance is underway.
turns.zh: 最终把股市从这个高度脆弱的状态里砸下去所需要的全部。所以这当然是要盯的东西，油价正在这里往上抬，我们会不会看到它清过95、96美元那道关——那将非常清楚地向技术派表明，下一轮潜在的看涨上攻正在展开。

turns.en: Alright now with this dollar strength we've seen precious metals remain under considerable pressure. We're now reaching lows from this year around $4,000 but speculative positioning also remains at the bottom of the range.
turns.zh: 好，随着这种美元强势，我们看到贵金属持续承受相当大的压力。我们现在正触及今年4000美元附近的低点，但投机性持仓也仍处在区间的底部。

turns.en: So what would you have to see here on this gold chart to tell you that this decline is developing into a genuine accumulation opportunity or is there still a risk that remains in this market?
turns.zh: 那么，在这张黄金图表上，你要看到什么，才会告诉你这轮下跌正在演变成一个真正的逢低吸纳（accumulation）机会？还是说这个市场里仍然留有风险？

turns.en: Now in the really big picture there is all sorts of arguments to be made that gold has a really big bull story ahead of it but the question is what are we going to see here on the short to intermediate timeframe?
turns.zh: 嗯，在真正的大图景里，有各种各样的论点可以说黄金前方有一个很大的看涨故事，但问题是，在中短期内我们要看到什么？

turns.en: Now here we continue to see technical deterioration and the big issue here is that overall the macro regime doesn't support higher gold when you have real rates rising and dollar funding stresses being very clearly evident.
